scope: Dedicated emulator IPv4/IPv6 outbound blocked except HDC replies; includes application loopback and WAN.
ipv4:
-P INPUT ACCEPT
-P FORWARD ACCEPT
-P OUTPUT ACCEPT
-N TM_OFFLINE
-N ohfw_FORWARD
-N ohfw_INPUT
-N ohfw_OUTPUT
-N ohfw_allowed_list_box
-N ohfw_dozable
-N ohfw_powersaving
-N ohfw_undozable
-A INPUT -j ohfw_INPUT
-A OUTPUT -j TM_OFFLINE
-A OUTPUT -j ohfw_OUTPUT
-A TM_OFFLINE -p tcp -m tcp --sport 55555 -j RETURN
-A TM_OFFLINE -j DROP
-A ohfw_dozable -j ohfw_allowed_list_box
-A ohfw_dozable -i lo -j RETURN
-A ohfw_dozable -o lo -j RETURN
-A ohfw_dozable -p tcp -m tcp --tcp-flags RST RST -j RETURN
-A ohfw_dozable -j DROP
-A ohfw_powersaving -j ohfw_allowed_list_box
-A ohfw_powersaving -i lo -j RETURN
-A ohfw_powersaving -o lo -j RETURN
-A ohfw_powersaving -p tcp -m tcp --tcp-flags RST RST -j RETURN
-A ohfw_powersaving -j DROP
ipv6:
-P INPUT ACCEPT
-P FORWARD ACCEPT
-P OUTPUT ACCEPT
-N TM_OFFLINE
-N ohfw_FORWARD
-N ohfw_INPUT
-N ohfw_OUTPUT
-N ohfw_allowed_list_box
-N ohfw_dozable
-N ohfw_powersaving
-N ohfw_undozable
-A INPUT -j ohfw_INPUT
-A OUTPUT -j TM_OFFLINE
-A OUTPUT -j ohfw_OUTPUT
-A TM_OFFLINE -p tcp -m tcp --sport 55555 -j RETURN
-A TM_OFFLINE -j DROP
-A ohfw_dozable -j ohfw_allowed_list_box
-A ohfw_dozable -i lo -j RETURN
-A ohfw_dozable -o lo -j RETURN
-A ohfw_dozable -p tcp -m tcp --tcp-flags RST RST -j RETURN
-A ohfw_dozable -p ipv6-icmp -m icmp6 --icmpv6-type 135 -j RETURN
-A ohfw_dozable -p ipv6-icmp -m icmp6 --icmpv6-type 136 -j RETURN
-A ohfw_dozable -j DROP
-A ohfw_powersaving -j ohfw_allowed_list_box
-A ohfw_powersaving -i lo -j RETURN
-A ohfw_powersaving -o lo -j RETURN
-A ohfw_powersaving -p tcp -m tcp --tcp-flags RST RST -j RETURN
-A ohfw_powersaving -p ipv6-icmp -m icmp6 --icmpv6-type 135 -j RETURN
-A ohfw_powersaving -p ipv6-icmp -m icmp6 --icmpv6-type 136 -j RETURN
-A ohfw_powersaving -j DROP
